quest.title: Scenes from Life in Meropide: Treat the Symptoms
quest.description: Lechlade seems to believe that the source of his misery lies in the yellow-green stones...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Primogem x20, Mora x10000, Credit Coupons x280

dialogues.speaker: Lechlade
dialogues.text: I feel so weak... Must be those blasted yellow-green stones again...

dialogues.speaker: Lechlade
dialogues.text: Something's definitely wrong with those yellow-green stones... I think I'm going to die here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Lechlade
dialogues.text: In the long run, we'll all be "fine," but I'm going to be "fine" before you are.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait a minute, this guy doesn't sound fine at all!

response.speaker: Lechlade
response.text: No, I'm fine, literally. If something's wrong, it's too late anyway...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So are you alright or not?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's very confused. Can you please be more specific?

response.speaker: Lechlade
response.text: Specifically speaking, when I come to the production zone, I get headaches and heart palpitations, and my hands and feet grow cold!

response.speaker: Lechlade
response.text: I'm done for! Do you know what I mean? I'm done for!

response.speaker: Lechlade
response.text: It must be the yellow-green stones! They're evil! You know of those stones, right? The Central Laboratory of the Fontaine Research Institute...

response.speaker: Lechlade
response.text: The yellow-green stones destroyed everything!

choices.text: Please just go see a doctor.

response.speaker: Lechlade
response.text: I am a doctor! I know! Wait, I'm no longer a doctor. I lost my certification, and I can't give official diagnoses...

response.speaker: Lechlade
response.text: Please find a real doctor with certifications to save me! Please!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #This sounds pretty serious. Let's go find a doctor, {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: Why don't you rest up in the infirmary?
That's certainly a new way to use the word "fine."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You don't sound fine at all.

dialogues.speaker: Arderne
dialogues.text: Are you in trouble? Or are others in trouble? You both look healthy, so it must be the latter.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Indeed...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You explain Lechlade's situation.

dialogues.speaker: Arderne
dialogues.text: Him again, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you treat him?

dialogues.speaker: Arderne
dialogues.text: His headache? Or his delusions?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You mean he's not that sick?

dialogues.speaker: Arderne
dialogues.text: Based on his lab results, most likely not.

dialogues.speaker: Arderne
dialogues.text: I heard that he misdiagnosed a patient when he was still on the outside, ignoring some early warning results, and healthcare outcome... Well, he's been a little paranoid ever since.

dialogues.speaker: Arderne
dialogues.text: He's like that to others, and worse when it comes to himself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How about the yellow-green stones?

dialogues.speaker: Arderne
dialogues.text: No one else is having those same health issues, right?

dialogues.speaker: Arderne
dialogues.text: But I can't very well ignore him, so please, give him this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Isn't this Pure Water? Are you sure?

dialogues.speaker: Arderne
dialogues.text: Oh, so you know what this is. It's fine in the sense that it does no harm to the body, and it'll give him a boost.

response.speaker: Arderne
response.text: As far as I know, he stays away from these drinks. But I gave it to him before, telling him it was a health potion, and he did actually show more vigor after drinking it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, we'll give this to him. If it doesn't work...

response.speaker: Arderne
response.text: Then tell him to go lie down in the infirmary. If you tell him it's "doctor's orders," he'll listen.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Sure. Let's go back, {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: Why not just give him Fonta?

response.speaker: Arderne
response.text: That's the thing. Everyone here knows what Fonta tastes like.

response.speaker: Arderne
response.text: But based on my knowledge, he hasn't had Pure Water. After all, it's not very common here.

response.speaker: Arderne
response.text: I gave it to him before, telling him it was a health potion, and he did actually show more vigor after drinking it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back. The doctor gave you this.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Lechlade takes the Pure Water and drinks all of it immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Lechlade
dialogues.text: Ah, me, that's better! Vigor fills me once again!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wasn't that a little too fast?

response.speaker: Lechlade
response.text: Arderne is a really good doctor, and certified, too! The medicine he prescribes always works. Unlike mine...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But what about the yellow-green stones?

response.speaker: Lechlade
response.text: Suspicious, of course!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, guess his delusions can't be helped.

response.speaker: Lechlade
response.text: Now I can keep working! Thank you so much for helping out. Here, take these Coupons — just a little something to show my appreciation.

response.speaker: Lechlade
response.text: Stay healthy!

choices.text: I don't think you were sick at all.

response.speaker: Lechlade
response.text: No, no, I was sick — but you brought me the cure!

dialogues.speaker: Arderne
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Lechlade's just acting up again, that's all.
